name: Sum of Array
description: Adds all elements and stores the total
code:
# Sum of Array (RISC-V assembly)
# Adds every element of a[0] .. a[n-1]
#
# a0 = base address of the array
# a1 = number of elements n
# a2 = result: the sum

    li a0, 0x0          # base address of the array
    li a1, 0xA          # n = 10 elements
    li t0, 0x0          # i = 0
    li t1, 0x0          # sum = 0

loop:
    bge t0, a1, done          # i >= n -> finished
    slli t2, t0, 0x2          # t2 = i * 4
    add t2, a0, t2            # t2 = &a[i]
    lw  t3, 0x0(t2)           # t3 = a[i]
    add t1, t1, t3            # sum = sum + a[i]
    addi t0, t0, 0x1          # i++
    j loop

done:
    mv a2, t1                 # a2 = the sum
    slli t2, a1, 0x2          # t2 = n * 4
    add t2, a0, t2            # address just after the array
    sw  t1, 0x0(t2)           # store the sum after the array (address 0x28)
